sources.title: Ghostex README.md
sources.locator: Features; Supported agents; Install; Credits; License
sources.finding: Ghostex provides local native agent sessions, mobile remote access, coordinators, scheduled prompts, worktrees, searchable session history, diffs and optional plugins. iOS access is via TestFlight.

sources.title: Ghostex LICENSE
sources.finding: MIT applies to Ghostex source at the pinned revision; embedded third-party projects have their own terms.

sources.title: Ghostex v11.1.0 release
sources.finding: Release published 8 November 2026 with desktop and mobile artifacts.

sources.title: Ghostex skills/ghostex-help/references/settings.md
sources.locator: Privacy; Collaboration; Cloud Boxes; Git actions
sources.finding: Anonymous analytics is enabled by default with a toggle. Shared chats allow named guest messages with approval or direct Send mode and expiry. Agentbox can use Docker locally or on an SSH server; cloud boxes use users own Instabox/Boat accounts.

sources.title: Ghostex skills/ghostex-help/references/features.md
sources.locator: Changes view; Remote machines, web, and mobile
sources.finding: Changes view supports commit/push/create PR, line feedback and revert. Remote web and phone clients connect to the host.

sources.title: Ghostex account-login command
sources.locator: server/src/ghostex_cli/account_login.rs line 8 (HELP) and server/src/ghostex_cli/account_login_codex.rs lines 1-3 and 30 (HELP), release v11.3.0 commit be391fd; README.md line 140
sources.finding: Settings > Accounts runs ghostex account-login, which signs in to a Claude or Codex account through the provider's browser login and saves each as a separate profile (cswap or xswap) for automatic account switching; the README advertises Claude and Codex usage limits with automatic account switching.

sources.title: Ghostex Antigravity support at v11.3.0
sources.finding: Ghostex v11.3.0 includes Antigravity CLI in its agent launch path with model and effort launch options.

sources.title: Ghostex: server/src/typed_operations/beads.rs
sources.locator: Project Board command dispatch and create/update/close/comment operations; skills/ghostex-help/references/features.md Project board (Kanban)
sources.finding: The product board directly creates/edits/closes/comments on persistent project-local .beads records, not merely links to an external website. Cards have backlog/open/in-progress/test/review/done states, priority, labels, comments, dependencies and linked sessions. Start work dispatches an agent to a card; manually created sessions can associate with an existing card. The separately installed bd CLI is the storage dependency.

sources.title: Ghostex: skills/ghostex-help/references/settings.md
sources.locator: Cloud Boxes at 427-448; Collab at 365-381; server/src/cloud_boxes and collab_shim
sources.finding: Cloud Boxes use the user Instabox or Boat account and bill that account; phone-start can launch a box while the desktop computer is off. These are user-controlled external cloud accounts, not a Ghostex-operated execution service. Collab owner/guest chat permissions include approve, direct Send and View only; owner controls each shared chat. No named organization/workspace human roles or enterprise SSO are documented. The optional Collab service is separately installed and its hosted implementation is outside the inspected core source.
